pages.text: Breakable artifacts come apart into $(item)Artifact Fragments$(). Four of those make an $(item)Artifact Template$(), and a template transmutes into a random artifact, so anything you did not want feeds back into the pool.
pages.title: Artifact Creation
Artifact Fragments
pages.text: Each breakable artifact yields 3 fragments, which means two of them do not quite cover a template. Compatible artifacts from the Artifacts mod break down the same way.

pages.title: Transmutation
pages.text: Transmute the template at the $(l:raidborn:mechanics/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$(/l) for a random artifact. The pool covers Raidborn artifacts and compatible ones from the Artifacts mod, so the result is not limited to what this mod adds.
